title: Cutting out a section modulo an ideal from an étale algebra
statement: Let $A$ and $C$ be commutative rings with an $A$-algebra structure on $C$, let $J\subseteq A$ be an ideal and $\tau:C\to A/J$ an $A$-algebra homomorphism. Assume $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then there exist $g\in C$ and an $A$-algebra isomorphism $t:C_g/JC_g\to A/J$, where $C_g$ is the principal localization [def-weil-ring-localization-away], such that $t(q(c/1))=\tau(c)$ for every $c\in C$, with $q:C_g\to C_g/JC_g$ the quotient map.

source.place: Tag 07M7 (lemma-lift-section-smooth-morphism), last paragraph, with Algebra Tags 00U7, 00U8, 00CT

proof.text: The A-algebra map tau kills JC: the algebra commutation equation sends j in J to zero modulo J, and ideal extension lies in the kernel. Descend to C/JC and extend scalars along the surjective map A -> A/J to obtain an A/J-algebra section s.
Base change étaleness from A -> C to A/J -> S=C/JC using the quotient-tensor equivalence.
Apply the idempotent splitting theorem to s to obtain e in S and an equivalence psi:S_e -> A/J satisfying psi(c/1)=s(c). Choose g in C reducing to e.

Localization commutes with quotient: (C_g)/(JC)C_g is a localization of S at e. Uniqueness of localization gives an S-algebra equivalence E from this quotient to S_e. Restrict scalars to A and compose E with psi.

Transitivity of ideal extension identifies (JC)C_g with JC_g. Transport along this ideal equality to get t. On c in C the localization equivalence commutes with the structural map, and psi extends s, so t(c/1 mod JC_g)=tau(c).

proof_origin.description: Following Stacks Tag 07M7; explicit Lean localization and quotient compatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_localization_quotient_equiv_of_etale_section
    (A C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [Algebra A C]
    (J : Ideal A) (τ : C →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J)
    (hC : Etale (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A C)).op)) :
    ∃ (g : C) (t :
      (Localization.Away g ⧸ (J.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away g)))) ≃ₐ[A] (A ⧸ J)),
      ∀ c : C, t (Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        (algebraMap C (Localization.Away g) c)) = τ c
